narrative.northStar: A browser tool at the moment of decision
narrative.overview: This scoped system records the implemented warning and toolbar popup. The user explicitly requested a browser-extension appearance independent of Omni AI. Root DESIGN.md remains the authority for the surrounding app. This system applies to the installed extension and the matching app fallback.

rules.name: Independent Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve Footprint's own palette across both Omni workspace appearances; never inherit the app's lavender or glass styling.

rules.name: Decision Access Rule
rules.body: Keep Cancel and Proceed visible when content grows or height shrinks. The body may scroll to preserve both title and action access.

rules.name: Estimate Truth Rule
rules.body: Keep the illustrative methodology and provider-variation explanation with the numbers. Never present the values as measured usage or universal industry metrics.

dos: Do use the shared component and impact calculation for extension and fallback.
Do preserve independent colors, visible focus, themed selection and scrollbars.
Do retain drafts on cancellation and resume each approved request once.
donts: Don't inherit the host's glass, orbital, pixel or lavender decoration.
Don't send generation requests before consent when the host flag is enabled.
Don't infer image quantity from counts of objects in the depicted scene.
